article.title: Reasonable time for transmitting such notice.
article.content: A party receiving notice of dishonour, who seeks to enforce his right against a prior party, transmits the notice within a reasonable time if he transmits it within the same time after its receipt as he would have had to give notice if he had been the holder.
article.html:
107Reasonable time for transmitting such notice.

Section 107 · Chapter X · pages 23–24 of the Act

A party receiving notice of dishonour, who seeks to enforce his right against a prior party, transmits the notice within a reasonable time if he transmits it within the same time after its receipt as he would have had to give notice if he had been the holder.
